svg.title: World laws built from compositional mathematics
svg.desc: Animated material quantities, actual production and inter-member transfers computed by the bounded research engine. Formulas are available to researchers but are not directly disclosed to agents in the hidden-rule setting. This is a fixed probe, not evidence that scientists have emerged.
svg.text: World laws built from compositional mathematics
Renewal + delay + cross-feeding + congestion + shared queue | seed 7
Fixed engine probe / actual quantities and settled transfers / no LLM decisions
Route cost depends on submitted load.
Observable quantities + available operations + experimental feedback
Observe → hypothesize → test → communicate. Whether scientific practice emerges is the research question.
Bars use a fixed per-material scale; numeric labels give exact amounts. Moving pixels represent settled production or transfer.
